values.content:
=
Extract invoice details from the text below.

Return valid JSON only with:
vendor_name, invoice_number, invoice_date, po_number, due_date, currency, subtotal, tax_amount, grand_total, line_items (description, quantity, unit_price, total).

Use null for missing fields. Do not guess or calculate values.

Invoice:
{{ $json.text }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={{
  {
    model: "qwen2.5vl:7b",
    stream: false,
    format: "json",
    messages: [
      {
        role: "user",
        content: `Extract every invoice visible in the supplied image.

The image may contain one or multiple invoices.
Extract each invoice independently. Never merge details from different invoices.

First determine whether the image contains a readable invoice.

If the image is blank, empty, corrupted, unreadable, or does not contain an invoice, return an empty invoices array.

STRICT OUTPUT FORMAT:

{
  "invoices": [
    {
      "is_invoice": true,
      "reason": null,
      "vendor_name": null,
      "invoice_number": null,
      "invoice_date": null,
      "po_number": null,
      "due_date": null,
      "currency": null,
      "subtotal": null,
      "tax_amount": null,
      "grand_total": null,
      "line_items": [
        {
          "description": null,
          "quantity": null,
          "unit": null,
          "unit_price": null,
          "line_total": null
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}

RULES:
- Always return an object containing the "invoices" array.
- Every invoice must be a separate element in the array.
- If only one invoice exists, return an array containing one invoice.
- If multiple invoices exist, return one element per invoice.
- Never combine line items or invoice details between invoices.
- Include every schema field for every invoice.
- Use null for missing or unreadable values.
- If the image does not contain a readable invoice, return an empty invoices array.
- Do not invent, guess, infer, or calculate values.
- Extract only information visibly present in the image.
- Preserve monetary values as strings.
- Preserve quantity and unit separately.
- Return valid JSON only.
- Do not include Markdown, code fences, or explanations.`,
        images: [$json.imageBase64]
      }
    ]
  }
}}
